description: Non-circular measurement of V3 for 5_2 from the Borel-Pade pole map. The reality of V3 (GGM 6.1 keeps only Re V for sigma_3) forces Im(zeta13) = Im V1 = Vol, a constraint mentioning NEITHER candidate; the pole nearest that line fixes V3 = Re V1 - Re(pole), and the two candidate literals are compared only afterwards. Pre-registered gates G0-G3 fixed before the first run; the G3 near-miss is reported, not suppressed. auditOnly; comparison to observed; no fit; nothing wired.

pade_branch_point_offset_POSTHOC.note: POST-HOC diagnostic, not a pre-registered gate; scores nothing. Answers whether the residual is truncation (it is not) or a common multiplicative systematic.
pade_branch_point_offset_POSTHOC.one_over_n2_law: (k12-1)*n^2 stays O(1) with no trend across the scan -- classical Pade branch-cut approach law
pade_branch_point_offset_POSTHOC.plateau_is_open: control-channel calibration improves V3 3.7x then PLATEAUS; a residual channel-dependent bias survives and is OPEN
pade_branch_point_offset_POSTHOC.retracted_claim: an earlier revision claimed the channels agree to 4.7e-6; that is a single-order ([11/12]) artifact ~1000x better than typical. Worst clean-order disagreement is 4.8e-3 in |dk|/k.

data.verdict: The reality-line pole selection (Im zeta = Vol, mentioning neither candidate) measures V3 = -7.744259484, favouring the published GGM value -7.69319082 over the corpus legacy literal -2.758099029 by 272.3x in relative deviation. Scope-(a): evidence about which V3 the phi_sigma1 series knows; NOT a derivation of the legacy literal's provenance, which remains OPEN. The ~0.664% residual vs GGM is NOT truncation (order-to-order motion is 1.5e-5, 440x smaller): D1 shows both the control channel zeta12 and the V3 channel carry a bias of the same sign and comparable size at every clean order, following the classical 1/n^2 branch-cut approach law -- the Pade-vs-branch-point systematic (a cut rendered as a pole line, leading pole outside it). Control-channel calibration improves V3 3.7x to -7.670908377 (rel dev 0.002896) then PLATEAUS at 0.00266: a residual channel-dependent bias survives and is OPEN. The calibration is POST-HOC and scores no gate.
